headline: TRITN led the movers with a +50.00% intraday move, while property trading was volatile and PF received a SET clarification.
market_take: The coverage universe showed sharp dispersion, led by TRITN at +50.00% and A at +29.91%, with declines concentrated in several property names. Trading activity was unusually elevated in PLAT, NOBLE, STECH and TRITN. Filings added event risk around PLE, NRF, NWR, ITD and PF, while PROP also had notable volume activity in LEE.

sector_notes.note: TRITN rose +50.00% on volume×3.12 and also triggered an unusual intraday-move alert. STPI fell -9.53%, while SOLAR gained +13.33% and had a 4.2σ volume spike.
A rose +29.91%, while PF fell -20.00%, NOBLE fell -18.52% and ORI fell -8.88%. PLAT rose +15.79% with a 69.9σ volume spike, and PF issued a SET clarification.
MADAME rose +11.45% with a +12.31% intraday move, while PLUS fell -10.00% and OKJ fell -7.02%. AQUA had a 4.3σ volume spike alongside quarter-3 earnings filings.
STECH rose +9.20% on volume×15.58, the strongest volume ratio among the listed top movers. GEL also recorded a 3.9σ volume spike.
LE E had a 48.7σ volume spike, while UVAN recorded a 4.3σ spike and PPPM had a +6.67% intraday move. SMO disclosed a chairman and board change.
